fixes.explanation: Verse 10 opens with, "Hate evil, O you who love the LORD!" Notice who it's aimed at: people who already love Him. Then it keeps going: "He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked." I think that's the reason for the command, friend. Loving Him and hating evil go together, and He's the One who keeps hold of you while you do it.
